title: Unique numerical expansion
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every function $\varphi:(\mathbb{F}_2^n)\to\mathbb{R}$, there is a unique assignment of a real coefficient $c(S)$ to each subset $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ such that, for every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, $\varphi(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}c(S)\prod_{i\in S}\mathbf{1}_{\{x_i=1\}}$.
